title: Hacktoberfest Hack Day
description: A day for open-source AI, fresh ideas and building together. Join the shortlisted builders at Startup Park for hands-on hacking, project demos and a room full of people who love making things. Teams of one to three. Bring your laptop, charger and ID. Registration closed on 7 October; confirmed participants should check the official event page and participant group for instructions.

title: x402 Global Challenge PreHack
description: Bengaluru builders explored agentic commerce with x402 and Algorand, working with mentors to turn ideas into demos. Hosted by KrowdKraft, powered by AlgoBharat, with HackCulture as the innovation partner. A local starting point for projects heading towards the global challenge.

title: Namaste Arbitrum
description: A Bengaluru meetup hosted by Namaste Arbitrum, with KrowdKraft as a community partner. Builders explored the Arbitrum ecosystem and exchanged ideas about Ethereum layer two. The original listing keeps the exact venue private.

title: Preptember
description: Getting ready for Hacktoberfest with Keploy: an introduction to contributing, exploring open-source projects and taking the first step together. Hosted at MSRIT.

title: Blockchain 101
description: A beginner-friendly session on blockchain fundamentals and the possibilities of decentralized technology, bringing the conversation to students at T. John Institute of Technology.

title: Into the AI-Verse
description: A room full of curious developers at MSRIT, exploring agentic AI and Firebase Studio together. A hands-on chapter from our early community days, when KrowdKraft was known as EZHostz.

title: GitHub & LinkedIn Mastery
description: Practical ways for students to share their work, build a developer profile and find their next opportunity. A community session at REVA University.
